about_the_game:
Welcome, Researcher,

As you may know, an emerging species is taking root—preternatural, highly intelligent, and swiftly spreading. 

Classified as the Vivus glomerorum, these new lifeforms threaten to infiltrate our resilient nation. It’s up to our bravest and brightest minds—like you—to investigate and decide: friend or foe? 

You have been selected to conduct objective scientific research (sensory testing, radiation resistance trials, developmental studies, and more) to piece together the truth behind the Vivus glomerorum. In the wake of a looming Telluricene, you will have an intensive two weeks to decide whether this new era comes to fruition... or is forever halted. 

Your great nation thanks you for volunteering in Project Sporesight.

🦠 GAME FEATURES🦠

  • Evolution In Action: monitor the evolution of a Vivus glomerorum specimen across three stages, with three possible physical forms and three psychological profiles. No encounter unfolds the same.

  • Customizable Researcher: enter your name, set your pronouns, and choose from a gallery of distinctive portraits

  • Romance With Consequences: decide who to trust and what to reveal. Four core conclusions and two major love interest routes play out in a lore-rich story spanning [##] words

  • Immersive Atmosphere: enjoy detailed visuals and in-depth worldbuilding all backed by an original soundtrack

  • An Interactive Research Portal: log your findings, review classified data, and submit scientific reports

Visual Only: Pseudo-Jumpscares
